This package is an **unofficial** LaunchDarkly server-side SDK for R.

```{r}
library(launchdarklyServer)

client <- ld_client(ld_config("sdk-key", offline = TRUE))
ctx <- ld_context("user-1", country = "us")
client$variation("flag", ctx, FALSE)
client$close()
```

For architecture details see `DESIGN.md` in the repository root.
